data.long_meaning: The name Keenan has its origins in Irish and is believed to have been derived from Old Irish 'Cináed', which means 'handsome' or 'noble'. Though not explicitly connected to any biblical or Christian figure, the name carries a sense of strength and dignity that is well-suited for a child in the Christian tradition. The name Keenan carries the meaning “Handsome, Noble” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Keenan usually hope their child will grow to embody handsome, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
